Book correction: The book prints \sin(\alpha - \beta) = \sin\alpha\cos\beta + \cos\alpha\sin\beta. This is wrong: the right side with + is \sin(\alpha + \beta). The correct identity is \sin(\alpha - \beta) = \sin\alpha\cos\beta - \cos\alpha\sin\beta, which is what the cross product proves.
